<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.mjs. Edit the repository definition and its Markdown documentation. -->

Create an ext4 image from a directory tree.

## Inputs

| Name   | Kind      | Description                                |
| ------ | --------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `tree` | directory | Directory tree to populate the filesystem. |

## Parameters

| Name                | Default | Description                                                                                                           |
| ------------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `size`              | `0`     | Capacity in bytes. Zero sizes the image from the tree and shrinks it after population.                                |
| `label`             | `""`    | Filesystem label. Empty leaves the label unset.                                                                       |
| `uuid`              | `""`    | Filesystem UUID. Empty derives a stable UUID from the normalized input archive.                                       |
| `block-size`        | `4096`  | Filesystem block size in bytes.                                                                                       |
| `reserved-percent`  | `0`     | Percentage of blocks reserved for the superuser.                                                                      |
| `mkfs-options`      | `""`    | Additional mkfs.ext4 arguments, separated with shell-style quoting.                                                   |
| `source-date-epoch` | `0`     | Filesystem creation, access, and change time and upper bound for modification times, as Unix seconds (0..4294967295). |

## Outputs

| Name    | Kind | Description                      |
| ------- | ---- | -------------------------------- |
| `image` | file | Populated ext4 filesystem image. |

## Execution

| Setting      | Value   |
| ------------ | ------- |
| Environment  | Bakery  |
| Output cache | Allowed |

## Behavior

Automatic sizing reserves space for file data and inodes, populates the
filesystem, and shrinks it with `resize2fs`. Choose an explicit capacity when a
deployment needs a fixed slot size. A tree that does not fit fails the build.

The default UUID and directory hash seed come from a sorted archive of the input
tree with normalized timestamps. Set `uuid` when another component needs a
particular filesystem identity. The rule does not select a root partition, boot
scheme, or update slot.

`source-date-epoch` fixes filesystem creation, access, and change times and
clamps file modification times. It defaults to zero. Identical tree metadata,
parameters, and Bakery tooling produce identical image bytes, including with
automatic sizing.

Additional `mkfs-options` use shell-style quoting to separate arguments. Bakery
does not perform shell expansion. Options that request random values or current
timestamps override the rule's reproducible defaults.

## Example

For example, package a prepared root filesystem:

```toml
uses = "core/image-ext4"
inputs.tree = { path = "prepared-root" }
parameters.label = "system"
```

Save this invocation as `root.toml` and run
`./run-bakery bake rule root.toml build/root`. The image appears at
`build/root/image`.
